THE END OF THE FREE MARKET (1860-1903]
1860-1870:
THE APEX OF COMPETITION
Free market enterprise hits its absolute
peak. Monopolies are merely barely
discernible embryos.
POST-1873:
THE CARTEL EMBRYO
A massive economic crash triggers the first
wave of defensive cartels. Transitory, fragile,
and treated as exceptions.
1900-1903:
THE FOUNDATION OF LIFE
Following severe crises, cartels become
the permanent foundation of all
economic life.
INSIGHT: The transformation of competition into
monopoly is one of the most important phenomena
of modern capitalist economy.
